children: Overview
Italy financial services group's first-half 2026 revenue grew 13.7% yr/yr
EBITDA for first half 2026 rose 20.8% yr/yr
Net income for first half 2026 up 69.0% yr/yr
Outlook
Moltiply expects Mavriq Energy & Telco to show improved year-on-year performance in Q3
Company expects BPO&Tech EBITDA growth in H2 at pace similar to H1
Moltiply Insurance sees structural growth from mandatory coverage for small businesses
Result Drivers
MAVRIQ DIVISION GROWTH - Revenue growth was mainly driven by a 31.7% increase in Mavriq Division revenues
BPO&TECH MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - BPO&Tech Division margins rose due to favorable service mix and productivity improvements, despite 8.0% revenue decline
INSURANCE SEGMENT DRIVERS - Insurance business grew due to regulatory changes and increased claims activity
